items.html: And being there, they are called only two Mochin. And the reason of the matter is that the coronet of Hesed in Daat, all of it was taken by ZA for himself, and that small amount that remained remained in the Yesod of ZA; and there remained in her only two Mochin, in this manner: the brain of Hochma within her is clothed in the Netzah of ZA, in the right cavity of the skull; and the brain of Bina, with the coronet of Gevura, is clothed in the Hod of ZA, on the left line.
